import pandas as pd

# Read the source CSV file with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_4/training_0.csv"
df_source = pd.read_csv(source_path, index_col=0)

# Group by 'fname' and count occurrences of 'fname' to get 'count_of_obs'
df_grouped = df_source.groupby('fname', as_index=False).agg(count_of_obs=('fname', 'count'))

# Ensure the data types match the target schema
df_grouped['fname'] = df_grouped['fname'].astype(str)
df_grouped['count_of_obs'] = df_grouped['count_of_obs'].astype(int)

# Rename columns to match target schema explicitly (already matched)
df_target = df_grouped[['fname', 'count_of_obs']]

# Write the result to the specified output path without the index
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_4/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
